# Telemetry test fixtures

Canonical JSON fixtures for unit tests, contract checks, and replay scenarios.

## Relationship to `docs/api/examples/`

Some fixtures have matching documentation examples (same payload shape, different audience). See [`docs/api/examples/README.md`](../../docs/api/examples/README.md) for the mapping table.

When changing a fixture used in tests, update the corresponding doc example if one exists.
